profile.name: Suryagarh Jaisalmer, Rajasthan
profile.badge_tooltip: Showcases sponsored, top rated vendors across budgets
profile.information:
The ideal venue for a dreamy palatial destination wedding. Suryagarh Jaisalmer sits on a threshold looking east towards the ancient city of Jaisalmer and west towards the Thar Desert whose rugged natural beauty provides venues and backdrops straight out of a royal fairy tale. The property itself is a magnificent fortress with a plethora of stately gardens and courtyards that leave you spoiled for choice while planning a dreamy palatial destination wedding. 

Space Available at Suryagarh Jaisalmer
The venue offers luxurious accommodation options for you and your guests, with well-appointed rooms and suites that are designed to provide a royal experience. The property also has a spa and wellness center for relaxation and rejuvenation. Yoga Garden and Khuzamsha Hall are both elegant indoor spaces that can accommodate up to 100-150 guests each. Both halls offer a beautiful ambiance that can be customized to suit your wedding style and preferences. With ample space and natural lighting, our indoor halls are perfect for an intimate wedding ceremony, reception or both. The Sunset Patio is a beautiful outdoor space that can accommodate up to 300-400 guests. The space is surrounded by lush greenery and offers a breathtaking view of the sunset, making it a romantic spot for your wedding ceremony or reception. If you're looking for a larger space, the Lakeside area by the pool is an ideal choice for a wedding. This space can accommodate up to 400-600 guests and offers a beautiful view of the pool and lake, creating a picturesque backdrop for your special day. With ample space and beautiful surroundings, this outdoor space is perfect for hosting your wedding ceremony and reception.

Services Offered by Suryagarh Jaisalmer
The experienced event planning team at Suryagarh Jaisalmer will work with you to meticulously plan and execute every aspect of your wedding, from venue selection to decor, entertainment, and more. They will ensure that your vision for your dream wedding comes to life. The culinary team will curate a customized menu for your wedding events, offering a delectable range of local and international cuisines. From halwai breakfasts to jazz brunches, and from Silk Route-themed sangeet dinners to indulgent after-parties, the food and beverage options at Suryagarh Jaisalmer will leave your guests craving for more. They can also arrange mesmerizing entertainers to add a touch of magic to your wedding celebrations.

Location
Suryagarh Jaisalmer is located in Kahala Phata, Sam Road, Jaisalmer, Rajasthan. It is 7 km from the abandoned village of Kuldhara, and 15 km from the Bara Bagh temple.

Latest Pricing & Photos of Weddings at Suryagarh Jaisalmer
Add to that a host of mesmerising entertainers, unmatched service and food and beverage options to ensure that with Suryagarh Jaisalmer your destination wedding will be nothing short of extraordinary. Book them but make sure to check the Suryagarh Palace photos and reviews before making your decision. profile.name: The Marugarh Resort & Spa
profile.information:
The Marugarh Resort & Spa is an outdoor wedding venue located in beautiful city of Jodhpur, India. It is a paradise offering luxurious amenities, stunning landscapes and breathtaking views. The Resort offers an exquisite venue for wedding celebrations amidst ancient architecture, gardens and a tranquil pool. With stunning areas for the ceremony, reception, and wedding photo shoots, it is both romantic and elegant. The Resort also features a range of dining options and a signature restaurant. A team of knowledgeable and experienced staff are available to take care of every detail according to your requirements, to ensure every aspect is covered. They also boast a range of luxurious, air-conditioned suites and rooms for the perfect honeymoon or staycation. Onsite, you will also find an outdoor pool, spa, fitness centre and gorgeous gardens, guaranteed to provide the perfect backdrop for your wedding photos. The Marugarh Resort & Spa looks forward to making your special day truly dazzling, and will ensure your experience is nothing short of extraordinary.

Space available at The Marugarh Resort & Spa
The resort offers a stunning and spacious lawn area that can accommodate a large gathering of 2000 to 3000 people, making it an ideal location for hosting grand wedding celebrations. The lawn at the Marugarh Resort & Spa is an open-air space that provides a breathtaking view of the ancient architecture and stunning landscapes. The ambiance of the lawn is both romantic and elegant, perfect for a dream wedding. The lawn is beautifully decorated with fresh flowers, lighting, and other decorations, making it look magical.

The spacious lawn at the Marugarh Resort & Spa is designed to cater to various wedding functions such as engagement ceremonies, sangeet, mehndi, wedding ceremony, and reception. The area can be customized to suit the preferences of the bride and groom, and the professional and experienced team at the resort will ensure that every detail is covered.

Facilities at The Marugarh Resort & Spa
The Marugarh Resort & Spa provides a range of facilities and services to ensure that your wedding day is unforgettable. They take care of every aspect from minor to major. Their facilities include:

In house catering only
In house Decor
In house DJ available, Outside DJ permitted
In house alcohol available, Outside alcohol permitted
Pool, spa
63 huge rooms
In house restaurant

profile.name: Rohet Garh
profile.badge_tooltip: Showcases sponsored, top rated vendors across budgets
profile.information:
Rohet Garh is a luscious venue based in Jodhpur and is perfect for the wedding events. As you pass through their towering fort gates, you’re instantly transported back in time. Built in 1622, this haveli retains much of its original charm and architecture. It has remained in the same family for the past 15 generations serving the past and the present.
If you’re dreaming of a wedding that eschews cold granite and glass in favor of history, where the walls whisper tales of valor and the gardens murmur of bygone romances, then House of Rohet is the place for you. 
If that was not enough - House of Rohet organises unique experiences that may be hard to find anywhere else- you can have your Mehendi curated as a Royal picnic on the banks of a serene lake or a cocktail amidst a shikar dinner setting where the canopy is a sky full of stars,  the bar is a Roeda tree and the only illumination is through the soft glow of a hundred  flickering flames.

Space available and capacity
With 3 uniquely designed Properties—House of Rohet offers 30-50 rooms in close vicinity of each other making it an ideal location for intimate weddings and mile stone celebrations having groups of 60-125 pax

Cuisines available
The kitchens are filled with royal recipes passed down through generations, the venues provide different settings and the rich local heritage provide myriad options ready to make your celebration truly unforgettable.
Equipped with world-class facilities, the venue is spacious and comfortable. They offer complete event support for all your nuptial ceremonies and events. With their class apart services, you are ensured that every experience with them is unique, every time. This venue is an ideal choice for your wedding events as it can hold lavish as well as a simple and subtle functions.
Vibrant and progressive, Hotel Rohet Garh retains the warmth and spirit of India. The services go far above and beyond the conventional venue and catering staples. All these services would be customised according to your demands, needs, and budget.
Let them  host your special day and weave it into our rich tapestry of traditions, stories, and folklore.^

vendors.name: Radisson Jodhpur
vendors.information:
A pure vegetarian boutique hotel that blends ancient-style architecture with modern amenities for a memorable stay in the Sun City. Our upscale property provides exclusively vegetarian dining options and proximity to destinations like the Clock Tower and Mandore Garden. When you aren’t sifting through 15th-century artifacts at Mehrangarh Fort, sit amidst the lush greens on our hotel grounds to admire the gold leafing, Haveli-style carvings, and regal red-sandstone façade.

Before exploring area attractions, have a hearty and healthy breakfast in our All Day Dining restaurant, and afterward, enjoy an endcap at one of our upcoming bars. You can connect to free Wi-Fi to find the perfect spot for a family picnic or ask our 24-hour concierge to recommend a destination for you. If you’re in town for work, book our Banquet Hall to give a professional presentation, or stop by the bar to conduct a more casual business meeting. When the day is done, swim in the pool or unwind in the on-site SVA Spa. Other amenities include:

Free Wi-Fi
Two restaurants - Ekatra All Day Dining and Abhiras rooftop Indian restaurant (Abhiras opening soon)
Two bars - 1459 and J Bar (both opening soon)
24-hour room service
Meeting facilities - Four banquet halls with a total area of 30,000 sq. ft.
Outdoor pool, open 07:00-20:00 (summer) and 07:00-19:00 (winter)
On-site SVA Spa, open 09:00-21:00, gymnasium open 06:00-22:00
24-hour airport transfer

Established in 2023, this eco-friendly resort offers a serene ambiance combined with modern amenities, ensuring a memorable experience for your special day.  

Space Available and Capacity at Dream Connect Resort
The resort features a spacious outdoor area, accommodating up to 150 guests, making it perfect for weddings, engagements, cocktail parties, and other medium-sized gatherings. It also allows intimate Pre-wedding events with a guest count of less than 50. The venue includes 10 well-furnished rooms, providing convenient accommodation for out-of-town guests and the wedding family.  

Cuisines at Dream Connect Resort
The resort is a vegetarian-only venue, making it an excellent choice for religious events or vegetarian weddings. The in-house catering team offers a variety of delicious and thoughtfully curated dishes to delight your guests.

Outside decorators permitted for customized décor  
in-house catering services ensuring high-quality food

Location of Dream Connect Resort
The resort is situated 10.6 km from Jodhpur Railway Station and is easily accessible via NH 62. Its convenient location, combined with excellent facilities, makes it a popular choice for weddings and celebrations in Jodhpur.

On The Farm (OTF) in Jodhpur is an enchanting open-air farmhouse-style wedding venue that perfectly captures authentic Rajasthani vibes for your special day. This beautiful wedding lawn offers couples a unique rustic charm combined with traditional elegance, making it an ideal choice for memorable wedding celebrations. Located conveniently in Jodhpur, this venue is perfect for anyone seeking a distinctive wedding location in and around Air Force Area and Cantt Area, providing easy accessibility for guests while maintaining its serene farmhouse atmosphere.

Space Available at On The Farm (OTF)
The venue offers a spacious outdoor setting perfect for various wedding ceremonies and celebrations:

Outdoor Lawn - Ideal for wedding ceremonies, reception parties, and pre-wedding functions with a seating capacity of 500 guests and floating capacity of 550 guests


Why you should choose this venue
On The Farm (OTF) stands out as an exceptional wedding destination with its authentic Rajasthani farmhouse ambiance that creates magical memories. The expansive outdoor lawn provides ample space for large gatherings while maintaining an intimate, rustic charm that's perfect for both traditional and contemporary wedding celebrations.

Planning your wedding budget is crucial, and On The Farm (OTF) offers competitive pricing packages for different wedding requirements. On The Farm (OTF) is conveniently located just 6.7 km from Jodhpur Railway Station, making it easily accessible for outstation guests. The venue's strategic location in Jodhpur ensures smooth transportation while offering the perfect blend of accessibility and tranquil farmhouse setting for your wedding celebrations.

vendors.name: Radisson Jodhpur
vendors.information:
A pure vegetarian boutique hotel that blends ancient-style architecture with modern amenities for a memorable stay in the Sun City. Our upscale property provides exclusively vegetarian dining options and proximity to destinations like the Clock Tower and Mandore Garden. When you aren’t sifting through 15th-century artifacts at Mehrangarh Fort, sit amidst the lush greens on our hotel grounds to admire the gold leafing, Haveli-style carvings, and regal red-sandstone façade.

Before exploring area attractions, have a hearty and healthy breakfast in our All Day Dining restaurant, and afterward, enjoy an endcap at one of our upcoming bars. You can connect to free Wi-Fi to find the perfect spot for a family picnic or ask our 24-hour concierge to recommend a destination for you. If you’re in town for work, book our Banquet Hall to give a professional presentation, or stop by the bar to conduct a more casual business meeting. When the day is done, swim in the pool or unwind in the on-site SVA Spa. Other amenities include:

Free Wi-Fi
Two restaurants - Ekatra All Day Dining and Abhiras rooftop Indian restaurant (Abhiras opening soon)
Two bars - 1459 and J Bar (both opening soon)
24-hour room service
Meeting facilities - Four banquet halls with a total area of 30,000 sq. ft.
Outdoor pool, open 07:00-20:00 (summer) and 07:00-19:00 (winter)

24-hour airport transfer

Perfect for your wedding celebrations, they offer a plethora of services and high quality amenities. Making your celebrations even better, they offer a pure vegetarian catering service prepared by experienced chefs with the provision of in-house bar. With all this, they also offer décor and design services and DJ entertainment services to make your celebrations joyous. To top it up, they also have a stunning outdoor area with swimming pool where the bride and groom can spend some romantic moments.

menuDetails.description: 3 Veg Starters,5 Veg Main Course,6 Veg Soups/salads,5 Desserts
menuDetails.name: Radisson Jodhpur
menuDetails.information:
A pure vegetarian boutique hotel that blends ancient-style architecture with modern amenities for a memorable stay in the Sun City. Our upscale property provides exclusively vegetarian dining options and proximity to destinations like the Clock Tower and Mandore Garden. When you aren’t sifting through 15th-century artifacts at Mehrangarh Fort, sit amidst the lush greens on our hotel grounds to admire the gold leafing, Haveli-style carvings, and regal red-sandstone façade.

Before exploring area attractions, have a hearty and healthy breakfast in our All Day Dining restaurant, and afterward, enjoy an endcap at one of our upcoming bars. You can connect to free Wi-Fi to find the perfect spot for a family picnic or ask our 24-hour concierge to recommend a destination for you. If you’re in town for work, book our Banquet Hall to give a professional presentation, or stop by the bar to conduct a more casual business meeting. When the day is done, swim in the pool or unwind in the on-site SVA Spa. Other amenities include:

Free Wi-Fi
Two restaurants - Ekatra All Day Dining and Abhiras rooftop Indian restaurant (Abhiras opening soon)
Two bars - 1459 and J Bar (both opening soon)
24-hour room service
Meeting facilities - Four banquet halls with a total area of 30,000 sq. ft.
Outdoor pool, open 07:00-20:00 (summer) and 07:00-19:00 (winter)
On-site SVA Spa, open 09:00-21:00, gymnasium open 06:00-22:00
24-hour airport transfer

Choose Garh Govind for the most auspicious moment in one’s life at where two hearts join with each other. To make their wedding great celebration, people from all around the world come to Jodhpur. In fact, it is one of the hotspots, when it comes to Royal weddings. They also provide on-demand facilities such as a tent, catering, lights, sound and folk dance with langas among others.

profile.name: Hotel Mapple Abhay
profile.information:
Hotel Mapple Abhay, located in Paota Circle, Jodhpur, is a wedding venue perfect for hosting lavish weddings and Pre-wedding functions. Established in 2001, the hotel offers a blend of modern amenities and an eco-friendly atmosphere, making it an ideal choice for couples looking to celebrate their special day in style. With a capacity to accommodate up to 300 guests, it is perfect for large weddings and celebrations.  

Space Available and Capacity at Hotel Mapple Abhay
The venue boasts a spacious indoor venue ideal for weddings, engagements, cocktails, and other events. The venue can comfortably accommodate up to 300 guests, making it a great option for large wedding events. The hotel also provides 72 rooms, ensuring that the wedding family and out-of-town guests have convenient and comfortable accommodation throughout the celebrations.  

Cuisines at Hotel Mapple Abhay
The venue offers a variety of veg and non-veg cuisines to suit diverse tastes and preferences. Additionally, it allows outside caterers, giving you the flexibility to choose specific caterers or food options for your wedding.  

Facilities Provided by Hotel Mapple Abhay
The venue offers:

Outside decorators permitted for personalized décor  
in-house and outside catering options available  
in-house DJ available; outside DJs also permitted  
Ample parking space for guests  
Alcohol services not available on the premises  


Location of Hotel Mapple Abhay
The venue is located just 2.8 km from Jodhpur Railway Station, easily accessible via Avesh Khan Lohani Circle Rd/High Court Rd. Its prime location makes it a convenient choice for wedding celebrations.

profile.name: Kurja Resort Jodhpur
profile.information:
Kurja Resort Jodhpur is a premier wedding destination nestled in the historic locality of Mandore, Jodhpur, offering couples an enchanting blend of traditional Rajasthani hospitality and modern amenities. This elegant resort stands out as an ideal choice for weddings with its professionally trained staff dedicated to creating exceptional experiences for domestic and international guests alike. Whether you're planning an intimate family celebration or a grand wedding affair, Kurja Resort provides the perfect backdrop for your special day with its stunning architecture and comprehensive wedding services that cater to families and large groups seeking memorable celebrations in Mandore.

Space Available at Kurja Resort Jodhpur
 The venue offers versatile spaces to accommodate weddings of all sizes:

Indoor Banquet Hall - Perfect for intimate ceremonies and receptions with 200 seating capacity and 400 floating capacity, featuring AC banquet facilities for year-round comfort

Outdoor Lawn - Spacious garden area ideal for grand celebrations, sangeet ceremonies, and outdoor wedding functions with impressive 2500 seating capacity and 4000 floating capacity

Guest Accommodation - 20 well-appointed rooms available for wedding guests and families, ensuring convenient stay arrangements



Why you should choose this venue?
 Kurja Resort Jodhpur offers the perfect combination of traditional Rajasthani charm and contemporary wedding facilities, making it an exceptional choice for couples seeking a memorable wedding venue in Mandore. The resort's experienced hospitality team ensures seamless wedding coordination, while the multiple venue spaces provide flexibility for different wedding ceremonies and celebrations. The venue's wheel chair friendly accessibility ensures all guests can comfortably participate in your celebrations. With both indoor AC banquet halls and expansive outdoor lawns, couples can host their dream wedding regardless of season or guest count.

How to reach
 Kurja Resort Jodhpur is conveniently located in Mandore, Jodhpur, making it easily accessible for wedding guests. The venue is situated just 1 km from Balsamand Lake Hotel, providing a helpful landmark for guests traveling to your wedding celebration. The resort's Mandore location offers excellent connectivity while maintaining the serene ambiance perfect for wedding festivities.

How much Kurja Resort Jodhpur costs for hosting weddings?
 Planning your wedding budget is crucial when selecting the perfect venue for your special day. The cost of hosting your wedding at Kurja Resort Jodhpur varies based on your specific requirements, guest count, and chosen packages. Contact the venue directly through WedMeGood to check for the best quote and their availability for your wedding date.

profile.name: Hotel Jodhpur Inn
profile.information:
Hotel Jodhpur Inn, located in Ajit Colony, Jodhpur, is a venue for hosting weddings and Pre-wedding functions. Since its establishment in 2022, the venue has become a popular choice for couples seeking an elegant and eco-friendly setting for their celebrations. Whether you're planning a lavish wedding or a more intimate gathering, Hotel Jodhpur Inn offers the perfect setting with modern amenities and flexibility.

Space Available and Capacity at Hotel Jodhpur Inn
The venue features an indoor banquet hall that can host up to 220 guests, making it suitable for weddings, engagement ceremonies, cocktails, and other events with a moderate guest list. The venue also offers 10 rooms, ideal for accommodating the wedding family and out-of-town guests, ensuring a comfortable stay during the celebrations.

Cuisines at Hotel Jodhpur Inn
The venue offers a variety of veg and non-veg cuisines, prepared to suit a range of tastes. It also allows outside caterers, providing you the option to choose your preferred caterer for the event, ensuring that your culinary needs are met to perfection.

Facilities Provided by Hotel Jodhpur Inn
The venue offers:

Outside decorators permitted to personalize the décor  
in-house and outside catering allowed  
in-house DJ available, with the option for outside DJs  
Ample parking space for guests  
Alcohol services not available on the premises  


Location of Hotel Jodhpur Inn
The venue is conveniently located just 3.1 km from Jodhpur Railway Station, easily accessible via Police Line Rd and Gaushala Rd. Its central location ensures your guests have a hassle free experience while attending your wedding.

Garh Govind resort is set amidst a beautiful and charming castle and that all you need for you and your family. The heritage hotel is constructed around a central courtyard in the true Rajasthani style. Built on the concept of a palace, the design bears true testimony to the architectural heritage of Jodhpur. Their luxury pool is designed with all natural rock and the plants like creepers and some shrubs and some trees like palm could give the feeling of an all natural sanctuary. Feel the luxury in the open sky and in the lap of nature. Relaxing rooms built with special Care gives you an experience to the royal palace that you are staying in.

Choose Garh Govind for the most auspicious moment in one’s life at where two hearts join with each other. To make their wedding great celebration, people from all around the world come to Jodhpur. In fact, it is one of the hotspots, when it comes to Royal weddings. They also provide on-demand facilities such as a tent, catering, lights, sound and folk dance with langas among others.

profile.name: Sb Hotel
profile.information:
SB Hotel is a premium wedding venue nestled in the historic city of Jodhpur, Rajasthan. Located in Mandore, near NLU College and Bijli Ghar, this elegant venue offers the perfect blend of traditional Rajasthani charm and modern amenities. Ideal for anyone looking for a wedding location in and around Mandore in Jodhpur, SB Hotel provides couples with an unforgettable setting to celebrate their special day. The venue combines spacious indoor and outdoor options, making it suitable for intimate gatherings as well as grand wedding celebrations.

Space Available at SB Hotel
SB Hotel offers versatile spaces to accommodate weddings of all sizes and styles:

Banquet Hall - Perfect for indoor ceremonies and receptions with 350 seating and 400 floating pax capacity, featuring AC facilities for guest comfort
Outdoor Lawn - Expansive space ideal for grand celebrations, mehendi ceremonies, and outdoor receptions with 3500 seating and 4000 floating pax capacity
7 Rooms - Comfortable accommodation options for the wedding party and out-of-town guests


Why you should choose this venue
SB Hotel stands out as an exceptional wedding destination in Jodhpur with its combination of spacious venues and convenient location. The venue offers both intimate indoor settings and expansive outdoor spaces, allowing couples to host multi-day celebrations seamlessly. With accommodation facilities on-site, guests can enjoy a comfortable stay while participating in wedding festivities. The venue's proximity to Mandore's attractions adds cultural richness to your wedding experience.

How much this venue costs for hosting weddings
Planning your dream wedding at SB Hotel requires understanding the investment involved for your special celebration. Wedding costs can vary based on your specific requirements, guest count, and chosen services. Contact the venue directly through WedMeGood to check for the best quote and their availability for their wedding date. The venue management can provide detailed pricing information tailored to your wedding vision and budget preferences.

How to reach SB Hotel
To reach SB Hotel in Jodhpur, head to Mandore, near NLU College and Bijli Ghar (the electric house), using local transport like auto-rickshaws or ride-sharing apps (Rapido is popular) from Jodhpur city, as it's a bit outside the main area but well-located for Mandore attractions.

profile.name: Karni Bhawan
profile.information:
Karni Bhawan, A Heritage Hotel in Jodhpur home of the erstwhile Jagirdars of Sodawas, Bhati Rajputs of the Lunar dynasty.This delightful red sandstone bungalow of the 40’s has been sensitively redone to meet the requirement of the discerning travellers. Lush green gardens combine a homely spirit with personal care of the family to make a stay at Karni Bhawan A Heritage Hotel in Jodhpur is very good value indeed.  Personal care is taken by the Owners and the Management of the hotel and the hospitality is extended to each guest. For the ones looking for a rooted, tradtional arrangement, this place is ideal for culture enthusiats.
Invited for several food festivals, Karni bhawan takes pride in raw culture and tradition represent the country across borders. The restaurant offers a whole range of exciting Tandoori, Punjabi and some Chinese dishes. Once an old Colonial bunglow now turned into a Hotel, consists of 30 rooms and suites altogther. All the 30 rooms and suites posses ethnic designs of Rajasthani festivity themes. Live entertainment facilities are also available on demand by Dhani - agroup of folk artists. During Summer, Pool side dinners can be arranged. Wellness and spa services like the herbal oil massage may also be availed on request. Guests can also enjoy a wild ride of Village Safari.

vendors.name: Garh Govind
vendors.information:
Garh Govind resort is set amidst a beautiful and charming castle and that all you need for you and your family. The heritage hotel is constructed around a central courtyard in the true Rajasthani style. Built on the concept of a palace, the design bears true testimony to the architectural heritage of Jodhpur. Their luxury pool is designed with all natural rock and the plants like creepers and some shrubs and some trees like palm could give the feeling of an all natural sanctuary. Feel the luxury in the open sky and in the lap of nature. Relaxing rooms built with special Care gives you an experience to the royal palace that you are staying in.

Choose Garh Govind for the most auspicious moment in one’s life at where two hearts join with each other. To make their wedding great celebration, people from all around the world come to Jodhpur. In fact, it is one of the hotspots, when it comes to Royal weddings. They also provide on-demand facilities such as a tent, catering, lights, sound and folk dance with langas among others.

profile.name: The Ummed Jodhpur Palace Resort & Spa
profile.information:
The Ummed Jodhpur is a prestigious hotel in Jodhpur known for its exceptional hospitality and services. Designed by acclaimed architect Hafeez Contractor, this 28-acre, five-star palace resort is nestled amidst stunning gardens, offering a serene escape within the captivating natural beauty of the Thar region. The architectural marvel reflects the grandeur of Rajasthan through breathtaking landscapes and intricate design elements like jalis, jharokhas, and domes, evoking the rich history and beauty of the region. The venue promises a mesmerizing journey through Rajasthan's enchanting tales and cultural heritage.

Space and Capacity available at The Ummed Jodhpur
The venue is a luxurious destination with a grand entrance featuring a palatial driveway and an elaborate welcome ceremony. The Marwar Lobby is adorned with folk paintings and artifacts, offering a glimpse of the opulence within. The accommodation comprises 88 palatial rooms and 8 grand suites, blending traditional richness with modern comforts and boasting lofty ceilings, intricate fixtures, handpicked paintings, and teak furnishings. The resort provides diverse indoor and outdoor venues, making it an ideal choice for royal weddings and corporate events in Jodhpur, Rajasthan. With six distinct venues and a seasoned event management team, The resort is a top-notch destination wedding venue embodying elegance and class. The venue offers four banquet halls. 

Sir Guman Court Hall: The hall is an indoor venue with the capacity to host 500 guests. The stately venue, with ornate ceilings and walls, is ideal for family functions and corporate events. The hall features audiovisual equipment, Wi-Fi connectivity, and other tech conveniences.
Chaarban: The hall provides an awe-inspiring venue, put together with an exquisite collection of catering and dining options for your special day. The grand lawn, with a capacity to accommodate 2000, is the perfect venue for your dream wedding in Udaipur.
Palace Lawn: The lawn offers a dreamy backdrop for the perfect wedding and unforgettable memories.
Poolside Lawn: the exquisite poolside lawn in Jodhpur is the perfect venue for weddings and pre-wedding functions. The traditional touches on this spacious open-air location, coupled with our personalized services, add a layer of glamour and suaveness to your celebrations.


Cuisines offered by The Ummed Jodhpur
The venue is one of the best in the industry to cater to your personalized venue needs. They tantalize your palate with unique culinary delights at coveted restaurants in Jodhpur. Some of the industry's top chefs oversee the restaurants, which offer a distinctive blend of traditional Indian food and other cuisines. They promise a blissful and jubilant dining experience.

Location of The Ummed Jodhpur
The resort is located in Jodhpur.

A pure vegetarian boutique hotel that blends ancient-style architecture with modern amenities for a memorable stay in the Sun City. If you’re in town for work, book our Banquet Hall to give a professional presentation, or stop by the bar to conduct a more casual business meeting. Free Wi-Fi

Two bars - 1459 and J Bar (both opening soon)
24-hour room service

Outdoor pool, open 07:00-20:00 (summer) and 07:00-19:00 (winter)

24-hour airport transfer
